claim_limits: This does not identify a structured-state mechanism or progressive optimality.
A pre-update program that selects the old Python version can fail D2 by construction; interpreter mismatch is diagnostic, not an algorithmic contribution.
Three repeats test whether an observed pattern recurs; they do not establish significant reliability improvement or noninferiority.
Artifact replay is separate from the historical end-to-end method when the submitted program must be recovered by the researcher.
Zero-model replay does not estimate counterfactual future repair tokens or an empirical break-even count.

historical_m1_context.accounting_note: All available model usage from scheduled arm executions is retained. Controller-only attempts and zero-model retries add no model tokens. Two interrupted Agent attempts have unavailable usage and are reported separately.
historical_m1_context.historical_state_persistence_issue: R1 v3 for positions 17 and 23 still records D1, and position 22 still records D0, despite D2 execution. Submitted program artifacts must therefore be treated as authoritative for any supplement; state-file persistence failures are retained as method cost.
